heap_investigation: Source inspection finds one restored display collection per loaded layer, shared evidence-table objects, Leaflet feature references plus LatLng and projected-point arrays, and retained cached layers. County display geometry has 116743 coordinate positions. restoreEvidence replaces the raw feature array instead of retaining a second raw collection; no canonical geometry bundle is fetched. Exact incremental-heap attribution is not established without a heap-snapshot study. Coordinator explicitly waived heap snapshots/dominators; phase_diagnosis records measured total heap and observable counts instead. Category retained byte sizes are unmeasured.

phase_diagnosis.method: Diagnosis only: marks and wrappers injected into responses by an OS-temp local server; shipped files untouched. Fetch wait includes response body transfer; Response.json is instrumented as Response.text then synchronous JSON.parse to split body wait from parse. Instrumentation overhead is included; these are diagnostic runs, not replacements for the three acceptance sessions. Per-layer shellAfter excludes adapter time; legend/results/capability/summary times are nested detail and must not be added twice. Collection category retained bytes are unmeasured.
phase_diagnosis.coordinator_interpretation: Renderer construction is faster than base; the strictly sequential request start sequence adds wait. Coordinator authorized proposed A8 as one reversible commit, pending the owner. Pending earlier responses still wait their turn; only failures must not block later layers. No new timeout.

proposed_A8.scope: Eligible default-on requests start together; parse, restore, adapter handoff remain one per task in config order with unchanged yields, states, retry and zoom/off gating. No renderer, threshold, budget or measurement-method change.
